[The structure of multidimensional concepts](https://philpapers.org/archive/CANTSO-17.pdf). (with Ilaria Canavotto, and Eric Pacuit)
]

*How do multidimensional concepts like healthy and democratic combine multiple dimensions into a single judgment? How best to 
deploy tools from social choice theory to understand them?*


[Temporal Symmetries of Inquiry](https://philpapers.org/rec/CARTSO-92). (with Nate Lauffer)
]

*Holding evidence for it fixed, whether a proposition is about the past or about the future does not matter to whether one is rationally permitted to inquire about it.* 

[Modeling Future Indeterminacy in Possibility Semantics](https://philpapers.org/archive/CARMFI.pdf)

*What would happen if instead of building semantics for the open future in terms of overlapping complete possible worlds, we did so on the basis of evolving incomplete possibilities?*
